reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, category_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE unit_cost_eur > (SELECT MAX(unit_cost_eur) FROM products WHERE category_id = 35)
alternatives:
WITH cables_top AS (
  -- one row in total
  SELECT MAX(unit_cost_eur) AS max_cost_eur
  FROM products
  WHERE category_id = 35
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.unit_cost_eur
FROM products p
CROSS JOIN cables_top c
WHERE p.unit_cost_eur > c.max_cost_eur

SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.unit_cost_eur
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM products c
  WHERE c.category_id = 35
    AND c.unit_cost_eur >= p.unit_cost_eur
)

other_way.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.unit_cost_eur
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM products c
  WHERE c.category_id = 35
    AND c.unit_cost_eur >= p.unit_cost_eur
)
other_way.tradeoff: NOT EXISTS says "no Cables product costs as much or more" and needs no aggregate, but reads less directly.
